content:
maria: Heads up, CI for master is red on linux-x86_64 — failing intermittently in tests/runtime/queue_order_test. Failure shows `assert(ordering == expected)` in Queue::pop. Anyone seen this lately?
kevin: Ugh, saw a red earlier but assumed a flaky hardware run. Can you paste the job link?
maria: ci-bot: Job failed — https://ci.example.com/builds/312345/steps/queue_order_test — output:
```
ASSERT failed: ordering == expected
stack: runtime::Queue::pop+0x1a3
...
```
kevin: Can you re-run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` and `CI_RERUN=1`? Also try `--repeat 100` on the test harness.
ci-bot: @maria re-run scheduled by @kevin: https://ci.example.com/builds/312346
olga: Heads up — yesterday I merged a small reorder optimization in scheduler/queue (PR #879). It touches the same codepath. Might be related. :eyes: 
sam: tagging in — I'm on debugger duty. Can you include the failing sha and core dump if available?
maria: sha: f2b4d9c. No core dump in that run. Local repro is flaky; sometimes passes.
kevin: Could be a data race/timing. Try building with `-Z sanitizer=thread` or run under `rr` if possible.
olga: The optimization added a relaxed atomic store in enqueue to speed up common case. If it's a race, adding a release fence might help. I'll take a quick look.
sam: I'll kick off a bisect across recent commits: `./scripts/ci-bisect.sh --range f2b4d9c..HEAD --test tests/runtime/queue_order_test --repeats 50`. Will report back in ~30m.
maria: thanks. If bisect lands on olga's PR we can revert or add a stronger ordering.
kevin: Also try forcing `RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=native'` off to rule out codegen reorder.
ci-bot: Bisect job queued: https://ci.example.com/bisect/9981 — monitor logs
sam: quick note — if you see nondet failures, please capture `env` and `/proc/interrupts` from the runner. helps rule out noisy neighbors.
maria: agreed. I'll add a repro harness in a forked job to collect environment.
olga: I pushed a tiny debug patch that adds an assert + counters to help narrow the window: PR #891. Can we run it on the failing job?
kevin: LGTM for debug-only. @ci-bot can we run PR #891 on the bisect runner?
ci-bot: PR #891 run queued against bisect runner.
sam: update — bisect narrowed to commit f2b4d9c..c3a9e4b, suspected commit c0dea33 changes scheduler queue ordering. Re-running with repeats 200.
maria: :thumbsup: assigning to @sam and @olga to own the next steps. Please post findings here.
sam: will do — if we can't reproduce reliably I'll instrument with `std::sync::atomic::fence(Ordering::SeqCst)` as a hypothesis.
olga: ack, I'm on standby. Thanks all.
maria: closing loop for now — keep updates in-thread. I'll open a follow-up doc if we need a rollback.
